 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 15-07-2024 Heard the parties.
2. The petitioners apprehend their arrest in connection with Shikarpur P.S. Case No. 85 of 2023 registered under Sections 406, 420, 504 and 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It is alleged that petitioners along with others took Rs. 3,40,000/- from the informant for sale the land but they sold the said land to another person.
When informant demanded his money then the accused persons refused and threatened the informant to kill him.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that petitioners are innocent and have falsely been Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.41460 of 2024(2) dt.15-07-2024 implicated in the present case.

Further submission is that the dispute involved in the alleged FIR is of a civil nature,
none of the acts allegedly committed by the petitioners gave rise to any criminal liability.
